variants.request: Make a basic calculator web app with a display, the four arithmetic operators, a clear button, and keyboard input.
Make a basic todo list web app where a task can be added, marked done, and deleted, with a count of the remaining tasks shown.
Make a basic unit converter web app for length and weight, with a dropdown for each unit and the result updating as you type.
Make a basic markdown note editor web app with an editor pane, a live rendered preview beside it, and notes persisted in localStorage.
Make a basic countdown timer web app where a duration is set in minutes and seconds, with start, pause and reset buttons and a visible alert when it reaches zero.
